mainEntity.name: How long does a typical hardwood flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of hardwood flooring installation varies based on the size of the area, the type of hardwood chosen, and the complexity of the subfloor preparation. For an average-sized room (around 250-300 sq ft), installation might take 2-3 days, including acclimation time for the wood. Larger projects or those requiring extensive subfloor leveling or removal of old flooring will naturally take longer. We provide a detailed project timeline after assessing your specific space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size and complexity. An average room might take 2-3 days, including wood acclimation. Larger projects or complex subfloor prep will extend the timeline.
